exposure: Robson Classification of Cesarean Birth subgroups
cohort: 1,000 women who delivered at Mizan Tepi University Teaching Hospital in the summer and fall of 2019
finding: Further analysis of risk factors associated with cesarean birth in women whose labor was induced or augmented, or those undergoing preterm birth, might offer additional target risk factors to modify.
mod_finding: The study found that cesarean birth rates varied among Robson Classification of Cesarean Birth subgroups, with the highest rates observed in groups other than primary cesarean among nulliparous and multiparous women.
